service.description: The file's columns (a repeated name once, with its count and first values), the mapping (target field to column: columnMapping overrides the preset's, an empty column leaves a target out; presetId jira, redmine, github or generic, found from the headers when empty), and each row read into a work item's values (item: sourceKey, sourceId, title, typeValue and purposeEnumId, statusValue and statusId, priorityValue and priority, assignee, reporter, createdDay, startDay, dueDay, resolvedDay, estimate in hours (estimateUnit seconds divides, as Jira's Original Estimate is), points, description, parentKey (else the epic), labels, milestone, release, sprint (the last of a repeated column) and earlierSprints, component) with its problems (no title: the row fails) and warnings (a value not read is left empty). valueMaps ({type, status, priority} of the file's value to a purposeEnumId, statusId or 1 to 9) override the guesses from the words; valueMapsUsed is the map of every value the file has, and distinctValues those values.

parameter.name: estimateUnit
parameter.description: hours or seconds; by default seconds for Jira's Original Estimate

service.description: The import's first steps: the preset found (or given), the columns with the target each maps to and their first values, the mapping, the first rows, the row count, and the file's types, statuses and priorities with the value each maps to (valueMapsUsed), for the mapping step.

actions.script: const read = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.WorkItemImportServices.read#WorkItemRows').parameters({workItemFile: workItemFile, fileText: fileText, fileLocation: fileLocation, characterSet: characterSet, presetId: presetId, columnMapping: columnMapping, valueMaps: valueMaps, maxRows: sampleSize}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return presetId = read.presetId columnList = read.columnList columnMapping = read.columnMapping estimateUnit = read.estimateUnitUsed targetFieldList = read.targetFieldList sampleRowList = Array.from(read.rowList || []).map((row) => row.values) rowCount = read.rowCount distinctValues = read.distinctValues valueMapsUsed = read.valueMapsUsed

service.description: What each row of read#WorkItemRows will do in the project: action create, update or skip (an item of the project with its original key in sourceReferenceId, by existingPolicy update or skip) or fail (its problems); the type and priority; the status fitting the project's flow (In Review and In Testing are In Progress on the Default flow); the assignee and reporter matched by user name, email or full name (one match only; else a warning and unassigned); the parent (a row of the file by its key or id, else an item of the project by its original key or its own key; else a warning and the top level); the labels and the milestone, release, component and sprint by name in the project (missing ones made by the import when createMissing, else a warning and left out). Lookups are cached for the rows.

parameter.name: allSourceKeys
parameter.description: The keys and ids of every row of the file (a preview plans a few rows)

service.description: The import's preview: the first maxRows rows (50 by default) as they will be made (plan#WorkItemRows), with the problems and warnings of each, and the counts over the whole file (rows, to create, to update, to skip, failing, with warnings).

Imports the rows of a work item file into the project rootWorkEffortId (plan#WorkItemRows for what each does). First the missing labels, milestones, releases, components and sprints (createMissing), each on its own; then each row in its own transaction (import#WorkItemRow): a row that fails is logged and named in failureList with its reason and values, and the rest are imported; then the parents (a row's parent from the file or the project, its own transaction each; one refused is a warning); then the sprints this import made that the file names as earlier sprints of an item (a carry-over) are completed, after their items are in them. The new items go after the project's others in the backlog's order, in the file's order.
With progressUserId, how far it is goes to that user as a NotificationMessage on the topic workItemImportProgress (not persisted unless the topic says so), every 25 rows and once at the end: {progressKey, done, total, createdCount, updatedCount, skippedCount, failedCount, finished}. A message that cannot be sent is logged and the import goes on.

parameter.name: existingPolicy
parameter.description: skip or update the rows already imported

service.description: One row of import#WorkItems, which runs it in its own transaction: the work item made (create#Task, its original key in sourceReferenceId, the reporter a Reporter party) or updated (the fields of the file; the status through set#TaskStatus, a move the flow refuses a warning), then its assignee, labels, plan items and sprint: an open sprint by set#TaskSprint, a complete one, and the earlier sprints it was carried over from, by their membership rows written directly (ended for the earlier ones).
